title: spergula rubra subsp. nicaeensis
intro: Spergula rubra subsp. nicaeensis, commonly known as red purslane, is a plant species within the Caryophyllaceae family. It is a succulent herb with potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of red purslane include reducing inflammation, improving wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
